locations.notes: settings.json is plain JSON (profiles, color schemes, keybindings) — validate it parses before reapply. All three documented variants covered: stable, preview, and unpackaged (Scoop/Chocolatey).
state.json is runtime window/tab state the terminal generates itself — taxonomic cache, never restored.
wt.exe app-execution alias — the terminal reinstalls with the app (Store/winget/Chocolatey); never copy the binary or alias.
